[[Image:Nemarellin Mountains map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''Nemarellin Mountains''' are a range which runs along the west coast of [[Illian]], and are sometimes called the "west wall of the country."

In the early part of {{ne|1000}}, [[Rand al'Thor]] assembled his army to repulse the [[Seanchan]] from the [[Venir Mountains]] in [[Altara]] in the Nemarellin range.
